title: Monty Hall: Let's Make a Deal
content: The contestant's door and the car location are independent causes of the door Monty opens. Observing the opened door conditions on their common effect and makes the two causes dependent.

variables.name: Location of Car
variables.content: The independently chosen location of the car.

variables.name: Door Opened
variables.content: The door Monty opens after consulting both other variables.

arrows.because: Monty must not open the contestant's chosen door.
In the real game Monty must not open the door containing the car.
